overall_strategy: Month 1 (new rescue adolescent): prioritize setup essentials (crate, harness/leash, bowls, cooling mat) as one-time purchases and establish predictable autoship deliveries for daily consumables. Main auto-ship: full-size kibble (high-protein large-breed 35-lb bag) to match Thor’s ~4 cups/day, plus multiple soft training treats to support intensive behavior work, and reliable waste bags and paw-care items timed to Thor’s yard/walk frequency. Because Thor is a strong chewer and high-energy, include scheduled replacement deliveries for heavy-duty chew toys so worn items can be swapped quickly. Seasonal/gear items (cooling pad, pool, LED leash, first-aid, crate, flirt pole) are one-time buys now — they address urgent heat and safety needs and durable training tools for the next many months. This mix reduces friction for daily care, keeps training consistent during this critical socialization and housetraining window, and avoids overstocking long-lived items while providing backups for high-use consumables.
